datasets.name: ds_port_perf
queryLines: SELECT * FROM ${catalog}.gold.mv_port_performance ORDER BY avg_turnaround_hrs DESC

datasets.name: ds_customer_rev
queryLines: SELECT * FROM ${catalog}.gold.mv_customer_revenue ORDER BY freight_revenue_usd DESC

datasets.name: ds_revenue_lane
queryLines: SELECT trade_lane, ROUND(SUM(freight_revenue_usd + dd_revenue_usd), 0) AS revenue_usd, SUM(teu) AS teu, ROUND(SUM(freight_revenue_usd + dd_revenue_usd)/NULLIF(SUM(teu),0),0) AS revenue_per_teu FROM ${catalog}.gold._rev_base GROUP BY trade_lane ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC

datasets.name: ds_revenue_month
queryLines: SELECT revenue_date, ROUND(SUM(freight_revenue_usd + dd_revenue_usd)/NULLIF(SUM(teu),0),0) AS revenue_per_teu, ROUND(SUM(dd_revenue_usd),0) AS dd_revenue FROM ${catalog}.gold._rev_base GROUP BY revenue_date ORDER BY revenue_date

datasets.name: ds_sustainability
queryLines: SELECT leg_date, vessel_class, fuel_type, ROUND(SUM(fuel_consumed_mt)/NULLIF(SUM(teu_nm)/1000.0,0),4) AS fuel_eff, ROUND(SUM(co2_mt)*1000.0/NULLIF(SUM(teu_nm)*1.852,0),4) AS co2_per_teu_km FROM ${catalog}.gold._sustainability_base GROUP BY leg_date, vessel_class, fuel_type ORDER BY leg_date

datasets.name: ds_ai_usage_endpoint
queryLines: SELECT * FROM ${catalog}.gold.v_ai_usage_by_endpoint ORDER BY total_tokens DESC

datasets.name: ds_ai_usage_user
queryLines: SELECT * FROM ${catalog}.gold.v_ai_usage_by_user ORDER BY total_tokens DESC

frame.title: CO₂ per TEU-km by Vessel Class
